title: Fix creature/NPC lore bleeding into action/reaction text
description: Creature/NPC post-stat-block flavor prose and Appendix MM-A intro prose are appended to the last action/reaction text (e.g. acolyte Club, knight Parry, ogre-zombie Morningstar). Add an optional data.description field, split trailing flavor into it using source paragraph-gap structure, stop appendix intro bleeding into ogre-zombie, add schema validation, parser+generated-pack regression tests, and an audit guard against lore/document prose in mechanical text.
notes: Implemented; PR #220 open (https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/220). Follow-up filed for emitting MM-A intro as a rule.
